Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Robertson
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 01/31/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 115 as introduced would increase the salary expenses of the Lawrence County and Limestone County Board of Registrars by an estimated annual maximum of $15,600 and $24,100, respectively, which is paid from the State General Fund. This could also increase the mileage, travel, and other expenses reimbursed to the Board from the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of additional meeting days and the number of members in attendance.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
